3. In the plaint, it was stated, inter alia, that the plaintiffs got title and possession in 'B' scheduled land measuring 2.58 acres by way of purchase which were contiguous to the suit land in the southern side. The suit land belonged to defendant No.2, Messer's Solenkhi Ceramic Industries Ltd. which was to the contiguous north and west of the plaintiffs land described in schedule- 'B'. Thus, the plaintiffs were Shafi-I-Jar (owner of adjoining immovable property). The plaintiffs got right of way over the suit land from 'B' scheduled land and as such, they were Shafi-I-Khalid to the suit land as well. The plaintiffs were in possession of 'B' scheduled land by purchase from the different owners. Plaintiff No. 1 purchased 18 decimals land out of 15 acres of C.S. and S.A. Plot Nos. 437 and 447 appertaining to C.S. Khatian No.94 and S.A. Khatian No. 219 of muza 563, Mirupr, Police Station-Joydebpur, Gazipur by registered Kabala No. 4849 dated 15.05.1991 from Zakir Hossain Chowdhury, son of late Shahabuddin Chowdhury in the same mouza. Plaintiff No.1 purchased 45 decimals land by Kabala No. 4848 dated 15.05.1991 from Rozina Chowdhury, wife of Zakir Hossain Chowdhury, out of 1.8½ acres land of S.A. Plot Nos. 437 and 447 appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 94 and S.A. Plot No. 438 appertaining to S.C. Khatian No. 42, S.A. Khatian No. 149, S.A. Plot No. 443 appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 49, S.A. Plot No. 449 appertaining to C.S. Khatian Nos. 49 and 182 and S.A. Plot No. 450 appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 1/56, S.A. Khatian No.47. Plaintiff No.1 purchased 33 decimals land out of 1.18½ acres land of those six plots from Raisa Rasul, daughter of the Atiqr Rasul by Kabala No. 4845 dated 15.05.1991 and also 33 decimals land out of those 6 plots from Saila Rasul, daughter of late Atiar Rasl by Kabala No. 4852 dated 15.05.1991. Thuse, plaintiff No. 1 got title and possession in 1.29 acres land in schedule- 'B' by purchase as stated above. Plaintiff No.2, Md. Nurul Islam, also purchased 33 decimals land from Raisa Rasul, daughter of late Atiar Rasul by Kabala No. 4835 dated 15.05.1991, 45 decimals land from Rajina Chowdhury, wife of Zakir Hossain Chowdhury by Kabala No. 4834 on the same day, 33 decimals land from Saila Rasul, daughter of late Atiar Rasul by Kabala No. 4837 of the same dated out of 1.81 acres land in 6 plots, i.e. S.A. Plot Nos. 437 and 447 of C.S. Khatian No. 94, S.A. Plot No. 438 of C.S. Khatian No. 42 and S.A. Khatian No. 149, S.A. Plot No. 449 of C.S. Khatian No. 49 and 182 and C.S. and S.A. Plot No. 450 of C.S. Khatian No. 1/56 and S.A. Khatian No. 47. Plaintiff No.2 also purchased 18 decimals land from Zakir Hossain Chowdhury, son of late Shahabuddin Chowdhury, out of .75 acre land of S.A. Plot Nos. 437 and 447 of C.S. Khatian No. 94, S.A. Khatian No. 219, R.S. Khatian Nos. 233, 230 by Kabala No. 4839 dated 15.05.1991. Plaintiff No. 2 got title and possession in 1.29 acres land in schedule- 'B'. Plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 together got title and possession in 2.58 acres land in schedule- 'B. 

 46. So far as the finding of the High Court Division as to the failure of the plaintiffs in proving their ownership of 'B' scheduled land is concerned, though they (the plaintiffs) filed the khatians only before the Courts below to prove their ownership, in this Court, they have filed all the relevant title documents by filing additional paper book to prove their ownership therein. We Wave perused the title documents and these documents prove that the plaintiffs have got title in 'B' scheduled land and as such, we find that the plaintiffs proved their ownership of 'B' scheduled land which is contiguous to the suit land.
